caveats: No free public source meets the >=3-year historical point-in-time market-cap gate.
CoinGecko free tier: 365-day history only; paid plans required for older data.
CoinPaprika free tier: 1 year daily history only; older data returns HTTP 402.
CoinMarketCap keyless public API: latest listings only; historical listings require API key (HTTP 403).
OKX and Hyperliquid: reachable but no point-in-time market-cap ranking history found.
CryptoDataDownload: free OHLCV CSVs since 2017 but no point-in-time market-cap ranking snapshots.
Wayback Machine archives CMC historical snapshots but requires HTML scraping; not a structured, reproducible, point-in-time ranking API.
No performance metrics or economic edge are claimed.
